Ex-Mossad Chief Warns of Iran War, Netanyahu Pushes for Strikes

Former Mossad chief David Barnea has stated that Israel must prepare for another war with Iran, suggesting that a deal with Tehran would not be sustainable. Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is reportedly seeking US backing for immediate strikes against Iran. However, Netanyahu faces internal resistance, with Gadi Eisenkot opposing immediate action. Avigdor Liberman has cautioned Netanyahu against launching an independent strike without US support. Reports indicate Netanyahu is increasing pressure on the US administration to strike Iran as soon as possible, but the White House is reportedly reluctant.
